tests.name: previous day skips the empty folder; Today comes back

steps.js: S.cards = await T.card.rendered('ha-plooum-gallery-card', 2); S.root = () => S.cards[0].shadowRoot; S.btn = (c) => deep(S.root(), c)[0]; S.times = () => deep(S.root(), '.thumb .time').map((e) => e.textContent.trim()).join(); await waitFor(() => deep(S.root(), '.thumb').length === 3 && !S.btn('.prev').disabled, 10000, 'ready');

steps.msg: next is disabled on the most recent day
D-2 shows 2 thumbnails (notes.txt ignored)

steps.assert: S.cards[0]._days[S.cards[0]._dayIdx].date === (() => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() - 2); return d.toLocaleDateString('en-CA'); })()
steps.msg: the displayed day is D-2, D-1 skipped

steps.js: await waitFor(() => !S.btn('.prev').disabled, 8000, 'prev enabled'); S.btn('.prev').click(); await waitFor(() => S.times() === '03:10', 8000, 'day -5');

steps.msg: previous is disabled on the oldest day

steps.js: S.btn('.today').click(); await waitFor(() => S.times() === '18:40,12:05,07:20', 8000, 'back to today');

steps.msg: Today is the most recent day again

tests.name: clicking a thumbnail or a timeline segment selects the clip

steps.js: S.cards = await T.card.rendered('ha-plooum-gallery-card', 2); S.root = () => S.cards[0].shadowRoot; S.src = () => deep(S.root(), 'video')[0]?.getAttribute('src'); await waitFor(() => deep(S.root(), '.thumb').length === 3 && S.src(), 10000, 'ready'); S.src0 = S.src();
deep(S.root(), '.thumb')[2].click(); await waitFor(() => deep(S.root(), '.thumb')[2].classList.contains('sel') && S.src() && S.src() !== S.src0, 8000, 'third thumbnail selected');

steps.msg: 07:20 selected in the grid and the timeline

steps.js: S.src1 = S.src(); deep(S.root(), '.seg').find((e) => e.getAttribute('title').startsWith('12:05:10')).click(); await waitFor(() => deep(S.root(), '.thumb.sel .time')[0]?.textContent.trim() === '12:05' && S.src() && S.src() !== S.src1, 8000, 'segment click');

steps.msg: the clicked segment is the selected one
